item.title: Vimeo’s Decline and Latest Layoffs After Bending Spoons Takeover
item.description: The latest round of job losses and massive cuts at video platform Vimeo implemented by serial asset stripper Bending Spoons leave it a shadow of its former self.

item.title: Why Humans See Green Best — And Why Video Codecs Are Built Around It
item.description: Replay: Several very important pieces of film and TV technology rely on the assumption that human beings can see green light best and that we can see sharp edges most clearly when they're rendered in shades of green rather than any other colour. Why?

item.title: Accsoon CineView M7 Update Brings Peaking Tool, Vertical Monitoring, and Nikon Support
item.description: A long list of new features for the well-regarded Accsoon CineView M7 Series monitors debuts courtesy of the latest firmware update.

item.title: Production Cart News Roundup: INOVATIV Acquisition, SmallRig Lite Cart, Tilta Boulder XL
item.description: There's been a flurry of stories involving production carts to kick off 2026, so we thought we'd round them all up into one easy-to-digest news story.

item.title: Leica sale talks could value iconic camera maker at $1.2 billion
item.description: Leica Camera AG is reportedly exploring a sale of a controlling stake in the company in a deal that could value it at approximately $1.2 billion.

item.title: Antigravity A1 Flight Simulator Update & 15% Off Sale | 8K 360 Drone Expansion
item.description: Antigravity looks to build on the A1 drone's launch momentum with new virtual Flight Simulator feature as well as limited-time deals to maximise sales.

item.title: Nikon ZR Firmware 1.10 Adds 6-Hour Recording, Timecode Input, and LUT Expansion
item.description: Nikon has released firmware version 1.10 for the Nikon ZR, taking recording times up to 6 hours as well as introducing some other valuable new features.

item.title: Aputure Announces NOVA 9° 2x1 and NOVA II 1x1 panel lights
item.description: Aputure has introduced two new NOVA LED panel fixtures, the NOVA 9° 2x1 hyper narrow beam panel and the NOVA II 1x1, alongside a new three-panel yoke array and a range of accessories.

item.title: OBSBOT Tiny 3 Series Launches with Spatial Audio and AI Tracking
item.description: OBSBOT has launched the Tiny 3 and Tiny 3 Lite, two new AI-powered 4K PTZ webcams that place a particular emphasis on integrated audio alongside upgraded imaging and tracking features.

item.title: Sony Unveils Cinema Line Firmware Roadmap Through 2026: VENICE 2, BURANO, FX6 & FR7 Details
item.description: Sony has released new information regarding forthcoming firmware releases for the VENICE 2 and BURANO, as well as confirming availability for FX6 V6.0 and FR7 V4.0 firmware releases.
